# Introduction {-}

The code in this books checks that the gun survey cleaning gives estimates 
of the national prevalence of gun ownership that roughly matches online sources.
We care most about whether our estimates match the papers from Cass and Colleen Barry
that analyze this exact data set.

The Gun Center has compiled links to the [survey reports](https://publichealth.jhu.edu/center-for-gun-violence-solutions/data/national-survey-of-gun-policy?). We use the papers and these reports to verify the correctness of the cleaning. 

There is not a good estimate of gun ownership in 2017.


Also in 2023, if I use weight3 (which is the weight that is scaled to gun owners and 
non gun owners) I get close to the 
[Pew Research Center](https://www.pewresearch.org/short-reads/2024/07/24/key-facts-about-americans-and-guns/) estimate of 32\% but if I use the "correct" weight `weight`, my estimate is close to 26\%.
